history.sg_progress: In September 2016, Business Intelligence Webi reports were made available in Umoja, with drill-down capabilities. The Administration also sends out monthly reports alerting clients about the status of the budget performance and highlighting areas that need further review, as well as vacancy status reports. The Webi reports were developed to assist departments and offices to monitor their expenditures in real time and to plan their work better during the biennium. As part of a continuous process improvement approach, the Office of Information and Communications Technology and the Umoja project team are collaborating with process owners to develop and enhance additional reports as required.
